_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A recording sent from a live conversation leaves the view there. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). There is a live conversation /c/live in the repository, whose drawer item is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='{{LIVE_ID}}']". The server refuses audio uploads (/api/upload/raw answers 503 "unavailable") until call "accept uploads". Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Click the start button, wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button. data-testid "review-recording-error" should be visible.
3. Call "accept uploads", then navigate to /c/live?{{QUERY}} and click data-testid "review-recording-send". It is sent.
4. Call "chats" should return exactly {"chats":1,"to_live":false}: one chat request, to a conversation other than the live one. It makes {{NEW_ID}} that conversation's id.
5. The new conversation shows up, but the view stays where the user is: ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='{{NEW_ID}}']" should be visible, the live conversation's drawer item should have class "active" (eval classList.contains("active"), expect true), and the page's URL should end with exactly "/c/live" (eval location.href.endsWith("/c/live"), expect true).
